title: user_account
description: A consumer account as seen by internal staff. docs/17 section 5. `ownerId` is omitted for a list/search action (there is no single account to own it); every per-account action supplies it.

goodwillAmountPts.description: TASKS.md 9.4.c: the goodwill credit being requested, in points -- the unit F12's per-case limit is stated in. Supplied by the staff controller on every goodwill_credit check, alongside goodwillCeilingPts.

goodwillCeilingPts.description: F12's goodwill-per-case limit for this account's region, read fresh from platform.region_setting (RegionSettingsReader) on every request -- never a constant. Absent means the rule below denies outright rather than trusting an unbounded amount.
